itinerary.title: Welcome to Singapore: Singapore City Tour
itinerary.description: Arrive in Singapore where you are greeted by our local representative outside the airport baggage hall. Embark on a half-day city tour featuring the iconic Merlion Statue at Merlion Park, panoramic skyline views from the Singapore Flyer, and cultural landmarks including Chinatown, Mount Faber, and the Jewellery Factory. Overnight in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Universal Studios Singapore
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel before heading out for a full day at Universal Studios Singapore at Resorts World Sentosa. Experience thrilling rides and attractions, meet characters like Gru, the Minions, Madagascar, Po, and Master Tigress, and visit the Far Far Away Castle to enjoy the Shrek 4-D attraction. Overnight in Singapore.

itinerary.title: MBS SkyPark & Gardens by the Bay
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, visit the MBS SkyPark Observation Deck located 56 storeys high for panoramic views of Marina Bay and the cityscape. In the evening, explore Gardens by the Bay, including the Cloud Forest with its indoor waterfall and aerial walkways, and the Flower Dome featuring plants from diverse global habitats. Overnight in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Sentosa Island Adventure & Madame Tussauds
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel and spend a full day exploring Sentosa Island. Highlights include a 1-way cable car ride, S.E.A. Aquarium, Wings of Time night show, Luge & Skyride (2 rounds), and the Madame Tussauds 5-in-1 experience featuring Images of Singapore, the Spirit of Singapore Boat Ride, Marvel 4D Cinema, Ultimate Film Star Experience, and the K-wave zone. Overnight in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Day Free for Shopping & Leisure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. The day is free at your leisure for shopping and exploring Singapore on your own. Overnight in Singapore.

itinerary.title: Departure from Singapore
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to the airport for your return flight home, concluding your memorable holiday with Widu Holidays.

itinerary.title: Arrival IXB Airport – Phuntsholing
itinerary.description: Meet and greet upon arrival at IXB Airport and transfer to the Jaigaon Indian border near Phuentsholing[cite: 2]. Our representative will meet you at the Phuentsholing gate. Overnight stay at the hotel in Phuentsholing[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Phuntsholing – Thimphu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Thimphu[cite: 2]. En route, visit Kharbandi Gonpa built in 1967 and enjoy magnificent views of the Indian plains and Toorsa River[cite: 2]. Pass through Chapcha and Chuzom before arriving in Thimphu[cite: 2]. Check in at the hotel for an overnight stay[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Thimphu Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a city tour visiting the King's Memorial Chorten, the 169-foot Buddha Point statue, National Library, Coronation Park, Takin Preservation Centre, and Chang Yul Park[cite: 2]. Enjoy an evening walk through Thimphu town. Overnight at a hotel in Thimphu[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Thimphu – Punakha
itinerary.description: Drive to Punakha across Dochula pass (3,080m)[cite: 2], which offers spectacular views of the eastern Himalayas on a clear day[cite: 2]. Visit the majestic Punakha Dzong[cite: 2] and take an excursion to Chimi Lhakhang, the temple of fertility[cite: 2]. Overnight at the hotel in Punakha[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Punakha – Paro
itinerary.description: Drive back to Paro via Wang Chhu and Paro Chhu river valleys[cite: 2]. En route, visit Simtokha Dzong[cite: 2]. Upon arrival in Paro, visit Ta Dzong (National Museum) and the historic Rinpung Dzong[cite: 2]. Overnight at the hotel in Paro[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Hike to Tiger’s Nest (Taktsang Monastery)
itinerary.description: Embark on a hike to Taktsang Monastery (Tiger's Nest), taking about 2.5 hours to reach the cafeteria viewpoint, with an optional 45-minute uphill walk for a closer view[cite: 2]. Enjoy lunch in town and explore Paro Bazar[cite: 2]. Overnight stay in Paro[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Chelela Pass Excursion
itinerary.description: Drive to Chelela Pass (3,988m), one of the highest motorable passes in Bhutan, adorned with sacred prayer flags and surrounded by Himalayan flora[cite: 2]. Evening drive back to Paro for an overnight stay[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Paro – Phuntsholing
itinerary.description: Drive back to Phuentsholing[cite: 2]. Our escort will assist you with exit formalities[cite: 2]. Overnight stay at a hotel in Phuentsholing[cite: 2].

itinerary.title: Phuntsholing – IXB Airport
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to IXB Airport where our escort will bid you farewell[cite: 2].

title: Bhutan Highlights & Scenic Getaway

itinerary.title: Arrival NJP/ IXB – Phuntsholing
itinerary.description: Meet and greet on arrival at NJP / IXB and transfer to the Jaigaon Indian border next to Phuentsholing[cite: 3]. A Bhutan representative will meet you on arrival at Jaigaon[cite: 3]. Evening free for leisure[cite: 3]. Overnight stay at the hotel[cite: 3].

itinerary.title: Phuntsholing – Thimphu
itinerary.description: After meeting your representative at the Phuentsholing gate, transfer to Thimphu with a stop at Kharbandi Gonpa (built in 1967)[cite: 3]. Enjoy magnificent views of the Indian plains and Toorsa River along the climb, passing the first hydro power electric project in Bhutan[cite: 3]. Lunch is served en route[cite: 3]. Continue past Chapcha and Chuzom to Thimphu[cite: 3]. Check in and overnight at the hotel in Thimphu[cite: 3].

itinerary.title: Thimphu Sightseeing – Paro
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy Thimphu sightseeing including the King's Memorial Chorten, the 169-foot Buddha Point statue, the National Library housing rare scripts and the world's biggest book, Coronation Park with the walking Buddha statue, and the Takin Preservation Centre[cite: 3]. Lunch will be served, followed by a drive to Paro for an overnight stay[cite: 3].

itinerary.title: Day 4 Options: Hike to Tiger's Nest OR Chelela Pass
itinerary.description: Choose between two wonderful options: Option 1 is a hike to Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) taking about 2.5 hours to the cafeteria viewpoint (with an optional 45-minute uphill walk closer), followed by lunch and time at Paro Bazar[cite: 3]. Option 2 is a drive to Chelela Pass (3,988m), one of the highest motorable passes in the country adorned with sacred prayer flags and Himalayan flora[cite: 3]. Evening drive back to Paro for an overnight stay[cite: 3].

itinerary.title: Paro – Phuntsholing
itinerary.description: Drive back to Jaigaon[cite: 3]. The Bhutan Buddha escort will assist you with exit formalities[cite: 3]. Overnight stay in Phuentsholing.

itinerary.title: Jaigaon - NJP / IXB Airport Drop
itinerary.description: Morning after breakfast, transfer from Jaigaon to NJP / IXB Airport for your departure[cite: 3].

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Dhow Cruise with Dinner
itinerary.description: On arrival at Dubai Airport, a local representative will welcome you and transfer you to your hotel[cite: 4]. In the evening, enjoy a romantic cruise on board an authentic Arabian wooden dhow along the creek, featuring a mouth-watering feast and views of moonlit Dubai landmarks[cite: 4]. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay[cite: 4].

itinerary.title: Half-Day Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa (Level 124)
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, proceed for a half-day city tour blending traditional gold souks with ground-breaking architecture[cite: 4]. Afterwards, visit 'At the Top' Burj Khalifa on Level 124 for captivating panoramic views of the city alongside a multimedia presentation on Dubai's history[cite: 4]. Return to your hotel for overnight[cite: 4].

itinerary.title: Deluxe Desert Safari with BBQ Dinner
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, leave your main luggage in the cloakroom and carry an overnight bag for your afternoon Desert Safari tour[cite: 4]. Experience an exciting 4x4 dune drive, followed by a camp featuring scintillating dance performances (Tanura, Horse, and Fire dance) and a delicious vegetarian/non-vegetarian barbecue dinner[cite: 4]. Overnight in Dubai[cite: 4].

itinerary.title: Dubai Miracle Garden
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, then proceed to the Dubai Miracle Garden, the world's largest natural flower garden featuring over 150 million flowers across 18 acres of vibrant, color-filled displays[cite: 4]. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Dubai[cite: 4].

itinerary.title: Departure from Dubai
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and transfer to Dubai airport for your flight back home[cite: 4].

In the evening, explore Dubai Garden Glow featuring 3D artworks, recyclable art displays, and the world's biggest dinosaur park with 100 animatronic dinosaurs[cite: 5]. Overnight stay in Dubai[cite: 5].

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour, Dubai Frame, Aquarium, Penguin Encounter & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a half-day Dubai orientation city tour blending old and new[cite: 5]. Visit the Dubai Frame for panoramic bird's-eye views and museum insights[cite: 5]. Experience 'At the Top' Burj Khalifa on Level 124[cite: 5], and explore the Dubai Mall Aquarium and Underwater Zoo featuring thousands of marine species and a special Penguin Encounter[cite: 5]. Overnight in Dubai[cite: 5].

itinerary.title: Museum of the Future & Deluxe Desert Safari
itinerary.description: After breakfast, visit the magnificent Museum of the Future to explore its 5 immersive floors of sustainable living and forward-thinking innovations[cite: 5]. In the afternoon, embark on an exciting Desert Safari tour with 4x4 dune bashing, live belly, Tanura, horse, and fire dance performances, and a delicious BBQ dinner[cite: 5]. Overnight in Dubai[cite: 5].

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi City Tour, Grand Mosque, Louvre & Warner Bros. World
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, proceed to Abu Dhabi for a city tour[cite: 5]. Visit the iconic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque with its 82 domes and gold-plated chandeliers[cite: 5], followed by the universal Louvre Abu Dhabi designed by Jean Nouvel[cite: 5]. Spend the rest of the day exploring Warner Bros. World Abu Dhabi, the world's largest indoor theme park featuring six immersive lands and thrilling 4D/5D rides[cite: 5]. Overnight in Abu Dhabi[cite: 5].

itinerary.title: Departure from UAE
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, check out and enjoy your transfer to the airport for your flight back home[cite: 5].

itinerary.title: Arrive Mauritius – Transfer to Hotel
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Mauritius International Airport, clear immigration and health check formalities and meet our local representative who will assist you with your transfer to the hotel on a seat-in-coach basis. Enjoy dinner at the hotel[cite: 9].

itinerary.title: Mauritius: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Spend the day at leisure to relax completely before starting sightseeing tours. Enjoy dinner at the hotel[cite: 9].

itinerary.title: Mauritius: North Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a North Island tour. Begin with a city tour of Port Louis, visit Fort Adelaide (Citadel) for panoramic viewpoints, explore the unique Kuan Fu Tea Factory, visit Caudan Waterfront shopping arcade, and stop at Bagatelle Mall for shopping. Return to the hotel for dinner[cite: 9].

itinerary.title: Mauritius: Ile Aux Cerfs Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed to Belle Mare beach where water sports are available at an additional cost. Continue to Trou d’eau Douce village for a thrilling speedboat ride across to Ile aux Cerfs Island to revel in fine white sands and clear blue waters. Return to the hotel for dinner[cite: 9].

itinerary.title: Mauritius: Day at Leisure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel. Spend the day at leisure exploring the island on your own, shopping, or soaking up the sun on the beach. Enjoy dinner at the hotel[cite: 9].

itinerary.title: Mauritius: South Island Tour
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on a full-day South Island tour. Visit the famous volcanic crater Trou aux Cerfs, Ganga Talao (Grand Bassin Shiv Temples), a model ship factory, Adams duty-free shop, and La Vallée des Couleurs Nature Park. Return to the hotel for dinner[cite: 9].

itinerary.title: Depart from Mauritius
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the hotel, check out, and transfer to the airport on a seat-in-coach basis for your flight back home[cite: 9].

title: Nepal Himalayan Scenic & Cultural Gateway
description: Discover the cultural and natural beauty of Nepal on a 6-day journey covering Kathmandu and Pokhara[cite: 10]. Experience sunrise views over the Himalayas from Sarangkot, boat rides on Fewa Lake, visits to sacred temples and stupas including Pashupatinath and Swayambhunath, and scenic drives along the Trishuli River[cite: 10].

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu & Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Arrival at Kathmandu International Airport. Meet and greet by our representative and transfer to the hotel for a welcome drink and tour briefing. Rest of the day is free for personal activities. Overnight in Kathmandu[cite: 10].

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Pokhara via Manakamana
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara (200 km / 6 hours) observing scenic views along the Trishuli River[cite: 10]. En route, optionally visit Manakamana Temple by cable car[cite: 10]. Upon arrival in Pokhara, check into the hotel and enjoy an evening walk around the Lakeside area with views of the western Himalayan range and Mt. Fishtail. Overnight in Pokhara[cite: 10].

itinerary.title: Pokhara Sunrise & Valley Tour
itinerary.description: Early morning proceed to Sarangkot (8 km from Pokhara) for panoramic mountain views as the sun transforms the peaks from purple-pink to celestial gold[cite: 10]. Later, embark on a sightseeing tour of Pokhara valley covering Davis Fall, Tibetan Refugee Camp, Seti Gorge, Mahadev Cave, Bindhyabasini Temple, and a 1-hour boat ride on Fewa Lake[cite: 10]. Overnight in Pokhara[cite: 10].

itinerary.title: Drive Back to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back to Kathmandu[cite: 10]. Upon arrival, check in at the hotel with the rest of the day free for personal activities. Overnight in Kathmandu[cite: 10].

itinerary.title: Kathmandu Full-Day Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day sightseeing tour covering Pashupatinath Temple, Bouddhanath Stupa, Patan Durbar Square with the oldest Krishna temple, and Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple) situated on a hillock overlooking the valley and eastern Himalayan range[cite: 10]. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay[cite: 10].

itinerary.title: Kathmandu – Departure
itinerary.description: Check out from the hotel and transfer to the airport for your flight back home[cite: 10].

title: Phuket & Krabi Tropical Beach & Island Explorer
description: Experience the stunning beaches and islands of Southern Thailand on a 4-night getaway covering Phuket and Krabi[cite: 11]. Enjoy a Phuket city tour, an unforgettable encounter at the Tiger Kingdom[cite: 11], a full-day big boat tour to Phi Phi Island and Khai Nok Island[cite: 11], and a classic 4-island long-tail boat tour in Krabi[cite: 11].

itinerary.title: Arrive Phuket – City Tour
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Phuket airport, meet our representative and transfer to your hotel. Embark on a Phuket city tour to admire the natural beauty of Thailand's largest island and stop for souvenir shopping. Overnight in Phuket[cite: 11].

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Island Tour by Big Boat
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for a full-day excursion to Phi Phi Island by big boat. Enjoy swimming and snorkeling among colorful corals at Phi Phi Don, discover the emerald lagoon of Pileh Bay, and gaze at the sculpted cliffs of Nui Bay. Enjoy a beachside lunch followed by free time at Khai Nok Island for swimming and relaxing. Return to Phuket for an overnight stay[cite: 11].

itinerary.title: Phuket Tiger Kingdom & Transfer to Krabi
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, visit the Phuket Tiger Kingdom for an unforgettable encounter to meet, play, and take photos with majestic tigers while learning about wild tiger conservation. Afterwards, drive by road from Phuket to Krabi, exploring the region's lush jungles, limestone cliffs, and Buddhist shrines near Tiger Cave. Overnight in Krabi[cite: 11].

itinerary.title: Krabi 4-Island Tour by Long-Tail Boat
itinerary.description: After breakfast, embark on Krabi's classic 4-Island tour by long-tail boat. Snorkel in the crystal-clear turquoise waters of Koh Poda, snap photos against iconic rock formations, and walk across the sandbar connecting Koh Mor and Koh Tub at low tide. Enjoy lunch and admire the spectacular limestone cliffs and rich marine life. Overnight in Krabi[cite: 11].

itinerary.title: Depart Krabi
itinerary.description: After breakfast at your hotel, proceed to the airport for your departure flight as your fantastic tour comes to an end[cite: 11].

title: Bangkok & Pattaya Highlights Explorer
description: Experience the vibrant culture and coastal beauty of Thailand on a 5-day journey covering Bangkok and Pattaya[cite: 12]. Enjoy the mesmerizing Alcazar Cabaret Show[cite: 12], speedboat tour to Coral Island (Koh Lan)[cite: 12], Pattaya Floating Market[cite: 12], Safari World and Marine Park[cite: 12], and a Bangkok temple and city tour featuring the Reclining and Golden Buddhas[cite: 12].

itinerary.title: Arrive Bangkok – Transfer to Pattaya & Alcazar Cabaret Show
itinerary.description: Arrive at Bangkok Airport, clear immigration, and enjoy breakfast with 3 hours room use at Zayn Express / Witz Hotel or similar[cite: 12]. Proceed to Pattaya, check in to the hotel, and in the evening enjoy the mesmerizing Alcazar Cabaret Show featuring elaborate stage designs and performances[cite: 12]. Overnight in Pattaya[cite: 12].

itinerary.title: Coral Island Tour in Speedboat
itinerary.description: After breakfast at the hotel, proceed to Coral Island (Koh Lan) via speedboat across the Gulf of Thailand[cite: 12]. Enjoy swimming, sunning, snorkeling, or optional water sports like parasailing and banana boat rides[cite: 12]. Return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Pattaya[cite: 12].

itinerary.title: Pattaya Floating Market – Transfer to Bangkok
itinerary.description: After breakfast and check-out, visit the Pattaya Floating Market featuring over 114 unique shops, boat rides, Thai delicacies, handicrafts, and souvenirs[cite: 12]. Afterward, proceed to Bangkok, check in to the hotel, and stay overnight[cite: 12].

itinerary.title: Safari World and Marine Park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed to Safari World and Marine Park, Thailand's largest open zoo spanning over 200 acres[cite: 12]. Drive through the African-designed Safari Park landscape to view hundreds of animals and explore the Marine Park[cite: 12]. Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bangkok[cite: 12].

itinerary.title: Bangkok Temple & City Tour – Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, enjoy a Bangkok temple and city tour covering iconic cultural attractions including the Reclining Buddha and Golden Buddha[cite: 12]. Later, you will be transferred to the airport for your flight back home[cite: 12].
